gloss: magnanimous; big-hearted; having great capacity as a person

definitions.gloss: magnanimous; big-hearted; having great personal capacity
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who has the capacity to lead, tolerate, and handle difficult situations without being petty. Implies large-scale thinking and generosity of spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{器|うつわ}が{大|おお}きい。
{器|うつわ}が{大|おお}きい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{怒|おこ}らない→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: A big-hearted person doesn't get angry over small things.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{器|うつわ}が{大|おお}きい⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Leaders are expected to be people of great personal capacity.

notes:
Literally "one's vessel is large." ⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧ (vessel, container) is used metaphorically to mean a person's capacity or caliber. A person with a large ⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧ can accommodate many people and situations. The opposite, ⟦{器|うつわ}が{小|ちい}さい→器が小さい：18883_utsuwagachiisai⟧, describes someone who is petty or narrow-minded.

USAGE:
Used as praise, typically for leaders or respected figures. Common in business and political contexts. Can also be used self-deprecatingly: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{器|うつわ}が{小|ちい}さい→器が小さい：18883_utsuwagachiisai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (I don't have the capacity for that).
